name: Cable High-to-Low Woodchop
steps: Stand sideways to a high pulley with both hands on its handle near the shoulder closest to the machine.
Turn your chest and hips away from the pulley and draw the handle diagonally toward the opposite hip.
Reverse the turn to guide your hands back up.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Let the trailing heel turn with your hips.
Keep your arms long so your core drives the rotation rather than your shoulders.
